title: 8-Mode Ring Long-Horizon Endurance Extension
intuition: Continues the candidate's converged `ring_hold` state without resetting or re-annealing to test whether all 8 modes and high sample quality (hq >= 0.90) persist over an extended training horizon.
failure_mode: Slow prior drift, step-size decay artifacts, or undamped minimax cycles cause delayed mode collapse hundreds of updates after initial convergence.
protocol_notes: Tier-3 required endurance task and Four Laws Adherence Law 3 anchor; uninterrupted continuation of `ring_hold`.
